card.name: Words leading into animal-source terms
card.fires_on: Small words or word starts just before a named animal, marine creature or animal-derived material, such as krill, crabs, lard or cartilage. It fires on the linking word, not on the animal itself.

modes.label: Before marine animals
modes.description: Adjectives, linking words or word starts in lists of sea creatures such as krill, crabs and foraminifera.

modes.description: Linking words before animal fats, cartilage or natural rubber.

card.writes: It pushes toward color words such as black and red, and away from wild and a few other tokens, which is only a loose output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on small words right before an animal or animal-derived thing is named.
